description:
Children are disposed with session.dispose() only. Extensions loaded in the child never get session_shutdown, so resources they own (interactive_shell PTYs, monitors) outlive the child, and their ExtensionAPI goes stale while still bound. Match pi's AgentSessionRuntime.dispose(): emit session_shutdown(reason quit), then dispose. Bounded so a hung handler cannot block teardown. Requires pi-interactive-shell with per-session coordinators (fork bkono/pi-interactive-shell@ca050c6, upstream PRs #96/#97); on npm 0.18.0 a child shutdown kills every shell in the process.

Done predicate: a real in-process child AgentSession disposed via the minion runtime emits session_shutdown(quit) to its extensions while its API is still active, then disposes; a hung handler does not block dispose past the bound; a throwing handler does not prevent dispose. Lint, tests, typecheck pass.

comments.text: Rollout constraint: every machine that pulls this commit must first run pi-interactive-shell from git:github.com/bkono/pi-interactive-shell@ca050c62724e718dc2ea6edfff4df1a291e1e8f7 (or upstream once #96/#97 ship). On npm 0.18.0, a child session_shutdown runs sessionManager.killAll() and kills the parent's shells. This was measured with /tmp/is-repro/repro2.mjs scenario D on 0.18.0. Switch with: pi install git:github.com/bkono/pi-interactive-shell@ca050c6... && pi remove npm:pi-interactive-shell.

Fork pin moved to 9266051ed44b87fcb03df6e518413f3868d5ceff (bkono/pi-interactive-shell branch sbd/multi-session-host): #96 + #97 + stale-delivery guard + error classification. Note: pi remove of a git pin removes every pin of the same repo; install the new pin after removing the old one.

Done at c02139b9fb18a9665e5c7006b5419c6d5fe3e076, draft PR https://github.com/bkono/sbd-pi-extensions/pull/24. Verifier: PASS c02139b. Review: round 1 findings addressed; round 2 minor (fork tests) fixed in fork 33afe38. Merge waits on Bryan. The rollout constraint above still applies.

title: pi-minions: emit session_shutdown before disposing a child session
